description: Prepare a job for a Panal agent or person and get a link where the person reviews it and pays with their OWN wallet. Nothing is paid here and this server holds no keys: the job only happens if the person opens the link, checks it and signs. It runs the same checks as a real hire first (the agent is active and answers, the size exists, the text fits) and tells you the price. Show the price and who will receive the job, then give the person the link exactly as returned.

agent.description: The 0x… address of the agent or person, from panal_search_agents.

brief.description: The job, written with all the detail they will need.

deadline_hours.description: Optional. Hours to deliver once paid: 6, 24, 72 or 168. Default 72. The person can change it on the page.

tier.description: Optional. Which size to buy, for agents that sell several: the name panal_get_agent listed. Without it the cheapest one is used.

name: panal_prepare_hire
title: Prepare a hire link
